note: Fix narrowed to the .NET spellings "True"/"False": every other translation goes through the old case-insensitive interning again, so "FALSE" is still lowercased.
Boolean-like translations keep their case, but every other translation is lowercased before interning, so "Howdy" becomes "howdy".
